subject: Pilot/POC Kickoff Recap: Redwood + Acme Corp
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC Kickoff - next steps

Hi Marissa / Aditya,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier today — quick recap from our side and a few open items so we can get the pilot started next week. High-level goals we agreed on:

- Reduce inference latency for our search reranking pipeline (current 95th pct ~450ms) to <200ms for 512-token workloads.
- Demonstrate 2x cost reduction for reranking compared to our current hosted model by using batching + quantization.
- Validate quality parity on our ecommerce prompt set (conversion-sensitive prompts) — target: <= 3% regression on top-K relevance metrics.

Key pain points we called out:
- Inconsistent latency spikes during peak traffic (deploys + cold starts)
- Lack of observability into token-level cost and per-prompt regressions
- Tight procurement timeline — we need initial results within 4 weeks to include in Q3 budget review.

Access/setup items we can action from Acme:
- Service account for SSO or API key that can call the Redwood demo endpoint (we prefer a scoped service account)
- Sample prompt set & eval script (attached)
- A small staging dataset for throughput tests (S3 link or shared Drive)

Attached: acme-prompt-set.xlsx (first-pass evaluation prompts + expected labels).

Open questions for Redwood:
1) Who will be our primary technical contact for infra/setup?
2) Proposed timeline and success metrics for the 4-week pilot (what does Redwood need from us to hit the timeline?)

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Director of Search Engineering, Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff - next steps

Hi Jordan — great call, thanks for the clear summary. Recapping from Redwood side and adding owners/timeline so we have a single source of truth.

Scope for the 4-week pilot (what we'll deliver):
- Integration: temporary scoped API access and onboarding to Redwood hosted test environment.
- Evaluation: run your provided prompt set + our QA prompts across three model configurations (baseline, quantized, and cached) and return utility & quality metrics.
- Perf: measure latency (p50/p95), throughput, and cost-per-1000-requests under a realistic replay of your staging traffic.
- Ops: set up tracing and token-level cost dashboards in console; create alert for latency or quality regressions.

Success metrics (proposed):
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for 512-token evaluation with target workload (staging replay).
- Cost: >= 2x cost reduction vs current hosted model (comparison method documented).
- Quality: <= 3% delta on top-K relevance/CTR surrogate on the provided prompt set.

Owners / Roles:
- Redwood AE: Marissa Cole — overall pilot lead, commercial coordination, weekly syncs.
- Redwood Eng (integration & perf): Aditya Rao — endpoint setup, load tests, kernel configuration, quantization trials.
- Redwood Eval & QA: Neha Kapoor — prompt set expansion, automatic eval harness, quality regression checks.
- Acme contacts: Jordan Ellis (search lead), Priya Singh (security/infra lead).

Proposed timeline:
- Day 0 (this week): Acme provides scoped credentials + prompt set (Jordan).
- Day 1-3: Redwood sets up test endpoints, initial smoke tests (Aditya).
- Week 1: Run baseline & cached runs, collect initial metrics (Neha/Aditya).
- Week 2-3: Quantization experiments, batching configs, and tuning; weekly sync on Wednesdays.
- End of Week 4: Final eval report + recommended production configuration + optional next steps (Dedicated capacity proposal if successful).

Immediate next steps (action items):
1) Jordan: share scoped service account or API key + S3/Drive link to staging dataset (by EOD Thu).
2) Aditya: provisioning plan & initial ETA to Jordan (by tomorrow).
3) Neha: confirm eval harness requirements (format of labels / scoring script) and sample output schema.
4) Marissa: schedule weekly check-ins — I’ll send a calendar invite for Wednesdays at 10am PT.

Attached: acme-poc-sow.pdf (draft SOW) and I’ll add the Redwood checklist link to the Drive.

If anything above looks off, flag it and I’ll update.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198
